title: Article 45 — Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years

content.overview: Article 45 directs the State to endeavour to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years. Verify the current official wording and its relationship to Article 21A.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Early childhood care and education policy; elementary education rights engage Article 21A and statute. Related: Arts 21A, 41, 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this as a freestanding justiciable right.
